Plumbing and heating services in Leeds

Everything below is carried out by our own directly employed engineers. Emergency work is available around the clock; planned work is booked within five working days.

Emergency repairs

Burst pipes, leaking joints, failed stopcocks and overflowing tanks. We isolate the leak first, then repair or replace the failed part. Most emergency repairs take under ninety minutes and are covered by our standard call-out charge plus parts.

Boiler repair and servicing

We service and repair Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Ideal, Baxi and Viessmann boilers. An annual service includes a flue gas analysis, a check of the expansion vessel and a written report. If a repair would cost more than 40% of a replacement, we say so and quote both options.

Blocked drains

High-pressure water jetting clears most blockages in a single visit. Every drain job includes a camera survey so you can see the cause, and we send the footage to you by email the same day.

Bathroom installation

From a tap swap to a full refit including tiling and electrics. We project-manage the trades so you deal with one person, and we give a fixed price for the whole job rather than a day rate.

Book a service

Call us or use the contact page. Emergency? Say so when you call and we will put you straight through to the on-duty engineer.
